name: Roses in the Thorns
source:
Fae Captain Ashley and Vampire Captain Klaus find themselves in a long and bitter war and are supposedly sworn enemies.  Both is given the task to kill the other, but will either of them be able to carry out their patriotic duty? Take control of each character and remember, your decisions will be the difference between life and death!

[from [url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/roses-in-the-thorns]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
妖精隊長阿什莉與吸血鬼隊長克勞斯身陷曠日持久的慘烈戰爭，按說該是不共戴天的仇敵。兩人都接到命令要殺死對方，其中任何一人能履行為國效命的職責嗎？輪流扮演兩位角色，別忘了，你的決定關乎生死！

［摘自[url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/roses-in-the-thorns]itch.io[/url]］
